result:
**QA-100877: BLOCKED.** The spec brand "Max" doesn't exist on the HBO Max account, so I stopped at step 3.

- **What ran:** I logged in, switched to the HBO Max account (the breadcrumb confirmed it), went to Brand → Content and opened the brand dropdown.
- **Why blocked:** Typing "Max" returns no result named exactly "Max". I retried after a page reload with slower typing and got the same list. Rule 1 says not to substitute another brand, so I didn't use "HBO Max" or any other near match.
- **Known issue:** This matches the existing quirk in `knowledge-base/known-quirks.md`. Max lives only on the Adam Orfei account, and there it has no Threads channel. I did not switch to Adam Orfei, since the precondition names HBO Max.
- **Not run:** Steps 3b–8 and all four assertions (A6, A7, A8a, A8b) were not evaluated. No bugs filed, and the case had no open linked bugs.

The report is `results/2026-10-20/QA-100877-report.md`, with screenshots in `.playwright-out/QA-100877/`. The report asks the test owner to retarget the case to an account/brand pair that has Threads, or to fix the stale brand name.
